set protocols bfd interface ge-0/0/0.0 m.template: set protocols bfd interface [parameter1] minimum-interval [parameter2] multiplier [parameter3]
set protocols bfd interface ge-0/0/0.0 m.explanation: Configure BFD (Bidirectional Forwarding Detection) protocol parameters for a specific interface, including the minimum interval and multiplier for detecting failures.

parameters.name: interface
parameters.explanation: The interface name and unit number for BFD configuration.

parameters.name: minimum-interval
parameters.explanation: The minimum interval, in milliseconds, at which BFD control packets are sent.

parameters.name: multiplier
parameters.explanation: The number of consecutive missed BFD control packets before the session is declared down.

set protocols bfd interface ge-0/0/1.0 m.explanation: Configure BFD (Bidirectional Forwarding Detection) protocol parameters for a specific interface, including the minimum interval between BFD control packets and the multiplier for detecting packet loss.

parameters.name: interface_name
parameters.explanation: The name of the interface to configure BFD on, including the unit number.

parameters.name: interval_value
parameters.explanation: The minimum interval, in milliseconds, between BFD control packets.

parameters.name: multiplier_value
parameters.explanation: The number of consecutive BFD control packets that must be missed before the session is declared down.
